title: Complete UI rework with glassmorphism navbar, gradient background with pixel clouds, and modern hero section

requirements.text: Remove the existing HellCodMC logo from the top-left corner by deleting the SiteLogo component references and file

quotes: Remove the existing "HellCodMC" logo from the top-left corner

acceptanceCriteria: SiteLogo component is not rendered in App.tsx
frontend/src/components/SiteLogo.tsx file is deleted
No logo image appears in the top-left corner

requirements.text: Create a new Header component with a clean, minimal, semi-transparent navigation bar featuring glassmorphism styling with soft blur, low-opacity background, and navigation items with smooth hover glow effects in bright cyan or soft purple with gentle transition animations

quotes: redesign the header with a clean, minimal, semi-transparent navigation bar. The navbar should feature subtle glassmorphism styling with soft blur and low-opacity background. Navigation items must have smooth hover glow effects in bright cyan or soft purple, with gentle transition animations.

acceptanceCriteria: Header component exists at frontend/src/components/Header.tsx
Navigation bar uses glassmorphism with backdrop-blur and low opacity background
Navigation items have hover glow effects in cyan or purple
Smooth CSS transitions are applied to all interactive elements
Header is responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints

requirements.text: Replace the current background with a smooth vertical gradient transitioning from rich medium blue at the top to soft light sky blue at the bottom, ensuring the gradient is clean and non-pixelated

quotes: The background should be a smooth vertical gradient transitioning from rich medium blue at the top to soft light sky blue at the bottom. The gradient must be clean and non-pixelated.

acceptanceCriteria: Background uses CSS gradient from medium blue to light sky blue
Gradient is smooth without pixelation or banding
Gradient covers the entire viewport and extends with page scroll

requirements.text: Overlay crisp, pixelated Minecraft-style white clouds with sharp square edges that drift slowly from left to right in a seamless loop, moving in a gentle wave motion with very slight stepped up-and-down pixel movement, keeping the sky smooth while clouds remain distinctly blocky

quotes: Overlay crisp, pixelated Minecraft-style white clouds with sharp square edges. Clouds drift slowly from left to right in a seamless loop, moving in a gentle wave motion with very slight stepped up-and-down pixel movement. The sky remains smooth while the clouds remain distinctly blocky.

acceptanceCriteria: Pixel-art clouds with hard square edges are overlaid on the gradient background
Clouds animate horizontally from left to right continuously
Clouds have subtle vertical wave motion in discrete pixel steps
Animation loops seamlessly without gaps or jumps
Clouds remain crisp and blocky against the smooth gradient

requirements.text: Redesign the hero section as a centered layout with strong visual hierarchy and balanced spacing, featuring a premium glassmorphism server IP card with semi-transparent dark blue background, soft background blur effect, rounded corners, subtle low-opacity white border, and soft layered shadow for depth separation

quotes: Design a centered hero section with strong visual hierarchy and balanced spacing. In the center, include a premium glassmorphism server IP card featuring: – Semi-transparent dark blue background – Soft background blur effect – Rounded corners – Subtle low-opacity white border – Soft layered shadow for depth separation

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section is centered with clear visual hierarchy
Server IP card uses glassmorphism with semi-transparent dark blue background
Card has backdrop-blur CSS effect applied
Card has rounded corners and subtle white border with low opacity
Soft layered shadow creates depth separation from background
Layout is responsive across all device sizes

requirements.text: Add a subtle animated cyan glow with smooth pulsing effect to the server IP text within the hero card

quotes: The server IP text should have a subtle animated cyan glow with a smooth pulsing effect.

acceptanceCriteria: Server IP text has cyan text-shadow or glow effect
Glow pulses smoothly using CSS animation
Animation loops continuously with appropriate timing

requirements.text: Include a minimal copy-to-clipboard button with a clean Minecraft-inspired pixel icon and hover feedback animation in the server IP card

quotes: Include a minimal copy-to-clipboard button with a clean Minecraft-inspired pixel icon and hover feedback animation.

acceptanceCriteria: Copy button exists next to or below the server IP
Button uses a Minecraft-style pixelated icon
Hover state provides visual feedback (color change, glow, or scale)
Button copies server IP to clipboard on click
Success feedback is shown after copying

requirements.text: Create three floating modern content cards below the hero card displaying 'Game Mode: Lifesteal SMP', 'Version: Any Version Can Play', and 'User Support: Both Java and Bedrock' with hover animations including slight lift effect, soft glow, and subtle scale increase, maintaining consistent spacing and alignment

quotes: Below the hero card, add three floating modern content cards displaying: – Game Mode: Lifesteal SMP – Version: Any Version Can Play – User Support: Both Java and Bedrock. These cards should feature hover animations including a slight lift effect, soft glow, and subtle scale increase. Maintain consistent spacing and alignment.

acceptanceCriteria: Three cards are displayed below the hero card
Cards show Game Mode, Version, and User Support information
Cards have consistent spacing and alignment
Hover state applies lift transform, glow effect, and scale increase
Cards are responsive and stack or resize appropriately on mobile

requirements.text: Update typography throughout the site with primary headings in pure white, secondary body text in soft icy blue, and accent phrases highlighted in bright cyan or soft purple

quotes: Typography: – Primary headings in pure white – Secondary body text in soft icy blue – Accent phrases highlighted in bright cyan or soft purple

acceptanceCriteria: All primary headings (h1, h2) use pure white color
Body text and secondary text use soft icy blue
Accent text uses bright cyan or soft purple
Typography is updated in Tailwind config and applied consistently
Text maintains strong contrast against the blue gradient background

requirements.text: Add a floating primary action button labeled 'Join Now' that combines a subtle Minecraft pixel aesthetic with modern UI polish, including soft hover glow, smooth transitions, and a gentle bounce animation for visual engagement

quotes: Add a floating primary action button labeled "Join Now." The button should combine a subtle Minecraft pixel aesthetic with modern UI polish. Include soft hover glow, smooth transitions, and a gentle bounce animation for visual engagement.

acceptanceCriteria: Join Now button is prominently displayed
Button has Minecraft-inspired pixel styling with modern polish
Hover state adds soft glow effect
Button has smooth CSS transitions
Gentle bounce animation enhances visual appeal
Button links to Discord server or appropriate destination

requirements.text: Ensure full responsive layout optimization for mobile (320px, 640px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1024px+) breakpoints with strong contrast, accessibility standards, and seamless animations across all device types

quotes: remember to optimize it for other device types too like mobile ,tab etc
Ensure strong contrast, accessibility, responsive layout structure, premium gaming aesthetic, modern SaaS-level polish, minimal clutter, seamless animations, and professional UI design quality.

acceptanceCriteria: Layout adapts smoothly to mobile (320px, 640px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1024px+)
Text remains readable at all breakpoints
Interactive elements are appropriately sized for touch on mobile
Animations perform smoothly on all devices
Color contrast meets WCAG accessibility standards
Navigation is usable on mobile devices

requirements.text: Remove the IntroSequence component and its associated state management from App.tsx to eliminate the black screen intro animation
acceptanceCriteria: IntroSequence component is not rendered in App.tsx
showIntro state and sessionStorage logic are removed

acceptanceCriteria: Background image reference is removed from index.css
